changelog:
- Daz Pose Gen 1.1 model is now available.

- Added new specialized experts on top of the 1.0 model to solve complex poses more effectively.
- Improved consistency for head and finger positioning.
- Prepared the architecture for the upcoming multi-person pose generation update.
- In the next update, the tool will be able to generate pose files for multiple people in the uploaded image.
- Various bug fixes and stability improvements.
